title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.33592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Augmented large language model (LLM) systems have reported high benchmark accuracies in rare disease diagnosis, yet their real-world clinical utility remains unproven. A recent meta-analysis flagged augmented LLM diagnostic evaluations as having a high risk of bias due to suspected data leakage; however, the precise impact of these vulnerabilities on model inference has yet to be fully quantified. In this study, we present a comprehensive empirical audit to quantify evaluation artifacts across prevailing AI paradigms, using a repository of over 60,000 cases from diverse public and independent clinical cohorts. By reconstructing a state-of-the-art agentic framework, we demonstrate that candidate-space contamination artificially inflates performance: enforcing strict cross-dataset isolation resulted in a marked performance decline, with the cross-dataset mean Recall@1 decreasing from 54.3% (under conventional one-vs-rest evaluation) to 40.

translated_title: 审计罕见病诊断中大语言模型系统的评估伪影与数据泄露问题
translated_abstract: 增强型大语言模型（LLM）系统在罕见病诊断中报告了较高的基准测试准确率，但其在真实世界中的临床实用性仍未得到证实。最近的一项荟萃分析指出，由于疑似存在数据泄露，增强型LLM诊断评估具有较高的偏倚风险；然而，这些漏洞对模型推理的精确影响尚未得到充分量化。在本研究中，我们利用来自多样化公共及独立临床队列的超过60,000个病例的资料库，开展了一项全面的实证审计，以量化主流AI范式中的评估伪影。通过重构一个最先进的智能体框架，我们证明了候选空间污染会人为地夸大模型性能：在实施严格的数据集间隔离后，模型性能出现显著下降，跨数据集平均Recall@1从54.3%（传统的一对其余评估方式下）下降至40…
tldr: 本研究对罕见病诊断中的增强型大语言模型系统进行了大规模实证审计，揭示了候选空间污染等数据泄露问题会人为夸大基准性能，严格的数据集隔离会导致模型性能显著下降。
en_tdlr: This study presents a comprehensive empirical audit of augmented LLM systems for rare disease diagnosis, demonstrating that candidate-space contamination and data leakage artificially inflate benchmark performance, with strict cross-dataset isolation causing marked performance declines.
